key_insight: The paper introduces the first semi-automated static analysis framework that combines functional verification with termination and resource-cost estimation for hybrid quantum programs with unbounded loops.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical path toward analyzing real quantum software with complex control flow, helping engineers reason about correctness and resource usage before execution.
method: Defines integer hybrid path-sums (IHPS) to represent executions of hybrid programs with unbounded while loops
Uses loop invariants to infer termination and expected resource consumption
Implements the approach as a semi-automatic Haskell tool
evidence_signal: The abstract reports the method is demonstrated on several examples and implemented in a semi-automatic Haskell program.
watch_item: The approach is semi-automatic and may depend on discovering suitable loop invariants, which could limit scalability on harder programs.
paper_title: An Effective Quantum Hoare Logic for Hybrid Quantum Programs with Unbounded Loops
